translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Wude the prefecture was abolished and Anxiang County was established within the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 11: Wu abolished; Anxiang in city.

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to Fenglin, taking the pass name.
Wu Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Wudu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Wudu commandery.

sentences.zh: ，置武州，領將利、建威、覆津、盤堤四縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Wu Prefecture was established, governing Jiangli, Jianwei, Fujin, and Pandi — four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Wu with Jiangli, Jianwei, Fujin, Pandi.

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenguan Jianwei was merged into Jiangli.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Wudu commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣三，戶一千一百五十二，口五千三百八十一。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed three counties, with 1,152 households and 5,381 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，戶二千九百二十三，口一萬五千三百一十三。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao there were 2,923 households and 15,313 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西一千二百九十里，至東都二千里。

translations.literal: It lay 1,290 li west of the capital and 2,000 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 1,290 li west of capital, 2,000 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: The land of the White Horse Di in Qin and Han times.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han White Horse Di land.

translations.literal: Han established the Wudu commandery and county.

sentences.zh: 後魏改武都為石門縣，置武州。

translations.literal: Northern Wei changed Wudu to Shimen County and established Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後周改為將利縣，仍置武都郡。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou changed it to Jiangli County and still established the Wudu commandery.

sentences.zh: 隋初廢，煬帝復為郡，皆治將利縣。

translations.literal: In early Sui it was abolished; under Emperor Yang the commandery was restored; all administered Jiangli County.
translations.idiomatic: Early Sui abolished; Yang restored; all Jiangli.

sentences.zh: 後魏置武階郡，又於今縣東北三十里萬郡故城置覆津縣。

translations.literal: Northern Wei established the Wujie commandery and at the old Wanjun city thirty li northeast of the present county established Fujin County.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei Wujie; Fujin at old Wanjun city.

sentences.zh: 隋廢武階郡，縣屬武都郡。

translations.literal: The Sui abolished the Wujie commandery and the county was subordinate to the Wudu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sui Wujie abolished; county to Wudu commandery.

translations.literal: Pandi, the territory of Han Hechi County, subordinate to Wudu commandery.

sentences.zh: 後魏於今縣東南百四十二里移盤堤縣于郡置武州。

translations.literal: Northern Wei moved Pandi County one hundred forty-two li southeast of the present county to the commandery and established Wu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei moved Pandi; Wu at commandery.

translations.literal: Named for Mount Pandi.
Tao Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Lintao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Lintao commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Tao Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: ，移州治于洪和城，後復移還洮陽城，今州治也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan the seat was moved to Honghe city and later moved back to Taoyang city — the present seat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan 9: to Honghe; back to Taoyang; present seat.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenguan a protectorate was established.
Abolished and merged into Min Prefecture.
Lingtan County established Lin Prefecture.
In the twenty-seventh year of Kaiyuan it was again changed to Tao Prefecture.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Lintao commandery.

sentences.zh: 管密恭縣，党項部落也，寄治州界。

translations.literal: It governed Migong County — a Tangut tribal prefecture administered within the prefectural bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Migong: Tangut tribe; administered in bounds.

translations.literal: After the Zhide era it was again made Tao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶二千三百六十三，口八千二百六十。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 2,363 households and 8,260 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，戶三千七百，口一萬五千六十。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao there were 3,700 households and 15,060 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西一千五百六里，至東都二千三百九十里。

translations.literal: It lay 1,506 li west of the capital and 2,390 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 1,506 li west of capital, 2,390 li to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢時羌地，本吐谷渾之鎮，謂之洪和城。

translations.literal: Qin and Han Di territory; originally the Tuyuhun garrison called Honghe city.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han Di land; Tuyuhun Honghe garrison.

sentences.zh: 後周攻得之，改為美相縣，屬洮州。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou captured it and changed it to Meixiang County, subordinate to Tao Prefecture.
In the fourth year of Zhenguan Tao Prefecture was administered from here.
Lingtan County was established, subordinate to Xu Prefecture.
In the eighth year of Zhenguan Xu Prefecture was abolished and assigned here.

sentences.zh: 其年，移理洮陽城，今州治也。

translations.literal: That same year the seat moved to Taoyang city — the present prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Same year: seat Taoyang; present seat.

sentences.zh: 仍于舊洪和城置美相縣，隸洮州。

translations.literal: Meixiang County was still established at the old Honghe city, subordinate to Tao Prefecture.
In the Tianbao era Meixiang was abolished and merged in.

sentences.zh: 岷州，下，隋臨洮郡之臨洮縣。

translations.literal: Min Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times Lintao County of the Lintao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Min Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Lintao in Lintao commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Min Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: ，為總管府，管岷、宕、洮、疊、旭五州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude it became a protectorate-general, supervising Min, Dang, Tao, Die, and Xu — five prefectures.
In the seventh year of Wude Fang Prefecture was added to supervision.
In the ninth year of Wude Wen, Wu, and Fu — three prefectures — were also supervised.
In the ninth year of Zhenguan it supervised Min, Dang, Tao, and Xu — four prefectures.
In the sixth year of Zhenguan it supervised Qiao and Yi — two prefectures.
In the twelfth year of Zhenguan the protectorate-general was abolished.
In the first year of Tianbao Dangyi County was abolished.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Hezheng commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Min Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣四，戶四千五百八十三，口一萬九千二百三十九。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed four counties, with 4,583 households and 19,239 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，縣三，戶四千三百二十五，口二萬三千四百四十一。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao three counties, with 4,325 households and 23,441 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西一千三百七十八里，至東都二千一百里。

translations.literal: It lay 1,378 li west of the capital and 2,100 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 1,378 li west of capital, 2,100 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Qin Lintao County, subordinate to Longxi commandery.

sentences.zh: 今州西二十里長城，蒙恬所築。

translations.literal: Twenty li west of the prefecture is the Long Wall built by Meng Tian.
translations.idiomatic: 20 li west: Long Wall of Meng Tian.

translations.literal: Mount Min lies one li south of the county.
Mount Kongtong lies twenty li west of the county.

sentences.zh: 後魏置岷州，仍改臨洮為溢樂。

translations.literal: Northern Wei established Min Prefecture and changed Lintao to Yile.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei Min; Lintao to Yile.

translations.literal: The Sui restored Lintao and in the fourth year of Wude renamed it Yile.
In the first year of Tianbao Dangyi was abolished and merged in.
Northern Zhou established Jicheng County.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to Youchuan, avoiding Emperor Xuanzong's taboo.
Northern Zhou established the Taocheng commandery.
In the first year of Tianbao Hezheng County was established.
Kuo Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Raohe commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Kuo Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Raohe commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Kuo Prefecture was established.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Ningsai commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Kuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶二千二十，口九千七百三十二。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 2,020 households and 9,732 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，縣三，戶四千二百六十一，口二萬四千四百。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao three counties, with 4,261 households and 24,400 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師二千三十里，至東都二千七百七十二里。

translations.literal: It lay 2,030 li from the capital and 2,772 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 2,030 li from capital, 2,772 li to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 後漢燒當羌之地，段熲破羌斬澆河大帥即此也。

translations.literal: The land of the Later Han Shaodang Qiang; Duan Jiong broke the Qiang and beheaded the Raohe great chieftain here.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han Shaodang Qiang; Duan Jiong beheaded Raohe chieftain here.

sentences.zh: 漢末，置西平郡，此地即南界也。

translations.literal: At the end of Han the Western Ping commandery was established; this place was its southern border.
translations.idiomatic: Han end Western Ping; southern border here.

translations.literal: Former Liang established the Huanghe commandery.
Northern Wei established the Shicheng commandery.

sentences.zh: 廢帝因縣內化隆穀改為化隆縣。

translations.literal: Emperor Fei because of the Hualong Valley within the county changed it to Hualong County.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Fei: Hualong Valley; Hualong County.

translations.literal: Northern Zhou established Kuo Prefecture.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to Huacheng County.
In the first year of Qianyuan it was changed to Guangwei County.
Within the county bounds is Mount Bayan.

sentences.zh: 達化後周置達化郡並縣。

translations.literal: Dahua: Northern Zhou established the Dahua commandery and county.
translations.idiomatic: Dahua: Northern Zhou commandery and county.

sentences.zh: 吐渾澆河城，在縣西一百二十里。

translations.literal: The Tuyuhun Raohe city lies one hundred twenty li west of the county.

sentences.zh: 米川漢枹罕縣地，屬金城郡。

translations.literal: Michuan, the territory of Han Fuhan County, subordinate to Jincheng commandery.
In the fourth year of Wude Mi Prefecture and Michuan County were established.
In the tenth year of Wude the prefecture was abolished and the county was subordinate to Kuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 10: Mi abolished; county to Kuo.

sentences.zh: 疊州，下，都督府，隋臨洮郡之合川縣。

translations.literal: Die Prefecture, lower grade, protectorate, in Sui times Hechuan County of the Lintao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Die Prefecture, lower protectorate: Sui Hechuan in Lintao commandery.

sentences.zh: ，置疊州，領合川、樂川、疊川三縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Die Prefecture was established, governing Hechuan, Lechuan, and Diechuan — three counties.

sentences.zh: 五年，又置安化、和同二縣，以處党項，尋省。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude Anhua and Hetong — two counties — were also established for the Tangut; soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 5: Anhua and Hetong for Tangut; soon abolished.

translations.literal: Diechuan and Lechuan counties.

sentences.zh: 十三年，置都督，督疊、岷、洮、宕、津、序、壹、枯、嶂、王、蓋、立、橋等州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Wude a protectorate was established supervising Die, Min, Tao, Dang, Jin, Xu, Yi, Ku, Zhang, Wang, Gai, Li, Qiao, and other prefectures.
In the first year of Zhenguan the protectorate was abolished.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Hechuan commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Die Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣一，戶一千八十三，口四千六十九。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed one county, with 1,083 households and 4,069 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣二，戶一千二百七十五，口七千六百七十四。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed two counties, with 1,275 households and 7,674 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西南一千一百一十里，至東都二千五百六十里。

translations.literal: It lay 1,110 li southwest of the capital and 2,560 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 1,110 li southwest of capital, 2,560 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Since Qin and Han the various Qiang held it as a stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Since Qin and Han various Qiang stronghold.

sentences.zh: 後周武帝逐諸羌，始有其地，置合川縣，仍於縣置疊州，取郡山重疊之義。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou Emperor Wu drove out the Qiang and first held the land, establishing Hechuan County and Die Prefecture at the county, taking the meaning of overlapping mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Zhou Wu drove Qiang; Hechuan and Die from overlapping mountains.

sentences.zh: 舊治吐谷渾馬牧城，，移於交戍城

translations.literal: Formerly administered at the Tuyuhun horse-pasture city; in the fourth year of Wude moved to Jiaoshu city.
translations.idiomatic: Former Tuyuhun horse city; Wude 4 Jiaoshu.

translations.literal: Changfen County of the Sui Tongchang commandery.

sentences.zh: ，置芳州，領常芬、恆香、丹嶺三縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Fang Prefecture was established, governing Changfen, Hengxiang, and Danling — three counties.
In the eighth year of Zhenguan Fang Prefecture became Changfen County, subordinate to Die Prefecture.
Dang Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Dangchang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Dang Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Dangchang commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Dang Prefecture was established.
It governed Huaidao, Lianggong, and Herong — three counties.
In the sixth year of Zhenguan Herong was abolished and merged into Huaidao.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Huaidao commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Dang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶一百四十，口一千四百六十一。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 140 households and 1,461 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，戶一千一百九十，口七千一百九十九。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao there were 1,190 households and 7,199 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西南一千六百五十六里，至東都二千二百八十五里。

translations.literal: It lay 1,656 li southwest of the capital and 2,285 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 1,656 li southwest of capital, 2,285 li to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 歷代諸羌所據，後魏始附為蕃國。

translations.literal: Held through the ages by various Qiang; Northern Wei first submitted as a frontier state.
translations.idiomatic: Various Qiang; Northern Wei frontier state.

sentences.zh: 後周置宕昌郡，及懷道、良恭二縣。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou established the Dangchang commandery and Huaidao and Lianggong — two counties.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Zhou Dangchang; Huaidao and Lianggong.

translations.literal: The Sui made it the Dangchang commandery.
In the Wude era it became Dang Prefecture, administered from Huaidao.

sentences.zh: 後周置陽宕縣，隋改為良恭。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou established Yangdang County; the Sui changed it to Lianggong.

sentences.zh: 河西道道，不在十道之內。

translations.literal: The Hexi Circuit road lies outside the ten circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi Circuit: outside the ten circuits.

sentences.zh: ，以江山闊遠，奉使者艱難，乃分山南為東西道，自黃河以西，分為河西道。

translations.literal: Because the rivers and mountains were vast and distant and envoys found the journey difficult, the south was split into eastern and western circuits; west of the Yellow River became the Hexi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Vast distance; south split east-west; west of Yellow River Hexi.

sentences.zh: 涼州，大都督府，隋武威郡。

translations.literal: Liang Prefecture, great protectorate, in Sui times the Wuwei commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Prefecture, great protectorate: Sui Wuwei commandery.

sentences.zh: ，平李軌，置涼州總管府，管涼、甘、瓜、肅四州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude, when Li Gui was pacified, the Liangzhou protectorate was established, supervising Liang, Gan, Gua, and Su — four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Li Gui pacified; Liang protectorate over four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 涼州領姑臧、昌松、番禾三縣。

translations.literal: Liang Prefecture governed Guzang, Changsong, and Fanhe — three counties.
In the third year of Wude Shenwu County was also established.

sentences.zh: 七年，改為都督府，督涼、肅、甘、沙、瓜、伊、芳、文八州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wude it became a protectorate-general supervising eight prefectures.
In the first year of Zhenguan Shenwu County was abolished.
It was restored.
In the second year of Zhenguan it became the Liangzhou great protectorate.

sentences.zh: 督涼、甘、肅、伊、瓜、沙、雄七州。

translations.literal: It supervised Liang, Gan, Su, Yi, Gua, Sha, and Xiong — seven prefectures.
In the sixth year of Zhenguan it became a middle protectorate.
In the second year of Zhenguan Jialin County was established.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Wuwei commandery, supervising Liang, Gan, and Su — three prefectures.
After the Zhide era it was again made Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣三，戶八千二百三十一，口三萬三千三十。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed three counties, with 8,231 households and 33,030 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣五，戶二萬二千四百六十二，口十二萬二百八十一。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed five counties, with 22,462 households and 120,281 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北二千一十里，至東都二千八百七十里。

translations.literal: It lay 2,110 li northwest of the capital and 2,870 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 2,110 li northwest of capital, 2,870 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Guzang, a Han dynasty county subordinate to the Wuwei commandery.
The seat of administration; in Qin times the Yuezhi Rong lived here.

sentences.zh: 匈奴本名蓋藏城，語訛為姑臧城。

translations.literal: The Xiongnu original name was Gaizang city; the word was corrupted to Guzang city.
Western Wei restored Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 晉末，張軌據姑臧，稱前涼。

translations.literal: At the end of the Jin Zhang Gui held Guzang and called it Former Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Jin end Zhang Gui Former Liang at Guzang.

translations.literal: Lü Guang also called it Later Liang.
Later it entered Northern Wei as the Wuwei commandery.
In the Wude era Li Gui was pacified and Liang Prefecture was established.
Within the prefectural bounds is Lake Zhuye.
Shenwu, Han Luaniao County, subordinate to Wuwei commandery.
Northern Wei abolished it.
In the fourth year of Wude Wuwei County was restored at the old Han Wuwei city.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Wuwei at old Han city.

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to Shenwu.

sentences.zh: 於漢鸞鳥古城置嘉麟縣

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenguan Jialin County was established at the old Luaniao city.
Changsong, Han Cangsong County, subordinate to Wuwei commandery.
Later Liang Lü Guang changed it to Changsong.

sentences.zh: 漢番音盤禾縣，屬張掖郡。

translations.literal: Fanhe, Han Panhe County, subordinate to Zhangye commandery.

sentences.zh: 縣南山曰天山，又名雪山。

translations.literal: South of the county Mount Tianshan, also called Mount Snow.

sentences.zh: ，於縣置雄州，，廢雄州，番禾還涼州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Xiong Prefecture was established at the county; in the eighth year of Zhenguan Xiong was abolished and Fanhe returned to Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Xiong at county; Zhenguan 8 Xiong abolished; Fanhe to Liang.

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to Tianbao County.
In the second year of Zhenguan it was established at the old Luaniao city.
Abolished; restored.

sentences.zh: :已上八州府，並無縣，皆吐渾、契苾、思結等部，寄在涼州界內。

translations.literal: The eight prefecture offices above had no counties; all were Tuyuhun, Qibi, and Sijie tribes lodged within Liang Prefecture bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Eight offices: no counties; Tuyuhun, Qibi, Sijie in Liang bounds.

sentences.zh: 共有戶五千四十八，口一萬七千二百一十二。

translations.literal: Together there were 5,048 households and 17,212 mouths.
Gan Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Zhangye commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Gan Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Zhangye commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude, when Li Gui was pacified, Gan Prefecture was established.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Zhangye commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Gan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶二千九百二十六，口一萬一千六百八十。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 2,926 households and 11,680 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，戶六千二百八十四，口二萬二千九十二。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao there were 6,284 households and 22,092 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北二千五百里，至東都三千三百一十里。

translations.literal: It lay 2,500 li northwest of the capital and 3,310 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 2,500 li northwest of capital, 3,310 li to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 故匈奴昆邪王地，屬漢武開置張掖郡及觻音祿得縣，郡所治也，匈奴王號也。

translations.literal: Formerly the land of the Xiongnu Kunye king; Emperor Wu of Han opened it and established the Zhangye commandery and Lude County — the commandery seat; it was a Xiongnu royal title.
translations.idiomatic: Xiongnu Kunye; Han Wu Zhangye and Lude; Xiongnu royal title.

sentences.zh: 後魏置張掖軍，孝文改為郡及縣，州置西涼州，尋改為甘州，取州東甘峻山為名。

translations.literal: Northern Wei established the Zhangye army; Emperor Xiaowen changed it to commandery and county; the prefecture was Western Liang Prefecture and soon Gan Prefecture, named for Mount Ganjun east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei Zhangye army; Xiaowen commandery; Western Liang then Gan; Mount Ganjun.

sentences.zh: 祁連山，在州西南二百里也

translations.literal: Mount Qilian lies two hundred li southwest of the prefecture.
Shandan, a Han dynasty county subordinate to Zhangye commandery.
Later Han split Zhangye to establish the Western Sea commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han split Zhangye for Western Sea.

sentences.zh: 晉分刪丹置蘭池、萬歲、仙提三縣。

translations.literal: The Jin split Shandan to establish Lanchi, Wansui, and Xianti — three counties.
translations.idiomatic: Jin split Shandan for three counties.

translations.literal: Emperor Yang abolished them and merged into Shandan.
Lake Juyan and Mount Yanzhi lie within the county bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Lake Juyan and Mount Yanzhi in bounds.

sentences.zh: 刪丹山，即焉支山，語訛也。

translations.literal: Mount Shandan is Mount Yanzhi — a corrupted pronunciation.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Shandan is Mount Yanzhi; corrupted.

sentences.zh: 肅州，下，，分隋張掖郡置肅州。

translations.literal: Su Prefecture, lower grade: in the eighth year of Zhenguan it was split from the Zhangye commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Su Prefecture, lower grade: Zhenguan 8 from Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 八年，置都督府，督肅、瓜、沙三州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Wude a protectorate was established supervising Su, Gua, and Sha — three prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 8: protectorate over Su, Gua, Sha.

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenguan the protectorate was abolished.
Under Zhenguan Yumen County was abolished.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Jiuquan commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣三，戶一千七百三十一，口七千一百一十八。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed three counties, with 1,731 households and 7,118 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣二，戶二千三百三十，口八千四百七十六。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed two counties, with 2,330 households and 8,476 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北二千八百五十八里，至東都三千七百八里。

translations.literal: It lay 2,858 li northwest of the capital and 3,708 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 2,858 li northwest of capital, 3,708 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Jiuquan, Han Fulu County, subordinate to Jiuquan commandery.

sentences.zh: 郡城下有金泉，泉味如酒，故為郡名。

translations.literal: Below the commandery city is the Golden Spring; the spring tastes like wine, hence the commandery name.
translations.idiomatic: Golden Spring below city tastes like wine; hence name.

sentences.zh: 此月支地，為匈奴所滅，匈奴令休屠、昆邪王守之。

translations.literal: This was Yuezhi territory; the Xiongnu destroyed them and had the Xiutu and Kunye kings guard it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhi land; Xiongnu destroyed; Xiutu and Kunye guarded.

sentences.zh: 漢武時，昆邪來降，乃置酒泉郡。

translations.literal: In the Han Wu era Kunye submitted and the Jiuquan commandery was established.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wu: Kunye submitted; Jiuquan commandery.

sentences.zh: 張軌、李暠、沮渠蒙遜皆都於此。

translations.literal: Zhang Gui, Li Gao, and Juqu Mengxun all made their capitals here.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Gui, Li Gao, Juqu Mengxun capitals here.

sentences.zh: 後魏置酒泉軍，復為郡，後周改為甘州，隋分甘州置肅州，皆治酒泉。

translations.literal: Northern Wei established the Jiuquan army, restored as commandery; Northern Zhou changed to Gan Prefecture; the Sui split Gan for Su Prefecture; all administered Jiuquan.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei Jiuquan army; Northern Zhou Gan; Sui Su from Gan; all Jiuquan.

translations.literal: In the first year of Yining Jiuquan County was established.
An old Han county subordinate to Jiuquan commandery.

sentences.zh: 今縣，漢樂涫縣地，屬燉煌郡。

translations.literal: The present county is the territory of Han Lequan County, subordinate to Dunhuang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Present county: Han Lequan, Dunhuang commandery.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Fulu County was established at the old Lequan city.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Fulu at old Lequan city.

sentences.zh: 瓜州，下，都督府，隋燉煌郡之常樂縣。

translations.literal: Gua Prefecture, lower grade, protectorate, in Sui times Changle County of the Dunhuang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Gua Prefecture, lower protectorate: Sui Changle in Dunhuang commandery.

sentences.zh: ，置瓜州，仍立總管府，管西沙、肅三州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude Gua Prefecture was established and a protectorate was still set up supervising the Western Sha and Su — three prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 5: Gua; protectorate over Western Sha and Su.

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Wude.
In the first year of Zhenguan the protectorate was abolished.
Under Zhenguan it was again a protectorate.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Jinchang commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Gua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶一千一百六十四，口四千三百二十二。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 1,164 households and 4,322 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶，戶四百七十七，口四千九百八十七。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao there were 477 households and 4,987 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西三千三百一十里，至東都四千三百六里。

translations.literal: It lay 3,310 li west of the capital and 4,306 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 3,310 li west of capital, 4,306 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Jinxing, Han Ming'an County, subordinate to Dunhuang commandery.
Ming is a river name.

sentences.zh: 置晉昌郡及冥安縣，周改晉昌為永興。

translations.literal: The Jin established the Jinchang commandery and Ming'an County; Zhou changed Jinchang to Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Jinchang and Ming'an; Zhou Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 隋改為瓜州，改冥安常樂。

translations.literal: The Sui changed it to Gua Prefecture and Ming'an to Changle.
In the first year of Tianbao it was again made Jinchang.
Guangzhi, Han Guangzhi County, subordinate to Dunhuang commandery.
Wei split Guangzhi to establish Yihe County.
Li Gao established the Liangxing commandery here.
The Sui abolished it and established Changle garrison.
In the fourth year of Wude the garrison was changed to a county.
Yi Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Yiwu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Yiwu commandery.

translations.literal: At the end of the Sui various Hu of the Western Regions held it.
translations.idiomatic: Sui end: Western Regions Hu held it.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude they submitted and Western Yi Prefecture was established.
In the sixth year of Wude the character xi was dropped.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Yiwu commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣三，戶一千三百三十二，口六千七百七十八。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed three counties, with 1,332 households and 6,778 mouths.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣二，戶二千四百六十七，口一萬一百五十七。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed two counties, with 2,467 households and 10,157 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北四千四百一十六里，至東都五千三百三十里。

translations.literal: It lay 4,416 li northwest of the capital and 5,330 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 4,416 li northwest of capital, 5,330 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: North of Dunhuang, beyond the great desert.
translations.idiomatic: North of Dunhuang beyond great desert.

translations.literal: In Qin and Han times the Rong lived here.

sentences.zh: 南去玉門關八百里，東去陽關二千七百三十里。

translations.literal: Eight hundred li south of Yumen Pass; two thousand seven hundred thirty li east of Yang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: 800 li south of Yumen; 2,730 li east of Yang Pass.

sentences.zh: 漢宣帝時，以鄭吉為都護，在玉門關。

translations.literal: In the Han Emperor Xuan era Zheng Ji was Protector-General at Yumen Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Han Xuan: Zheng Ji Protector-General at Yumen.

sentences.zh: 元帝時，置戊己校尉，皆治車師。

translations.literal: In the Han Emperor Yuan era the Wuji Colonel was established; both administered the Cheshi.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yuan: Wuji Colonel; both Cheshi.

sentences.zh: 後漢明帝時，取伊吾盧地，置宜禾都尉以屯田。

translations.literal: In the Later Han Ming era the Yiquan frontier land was taken and the Yihe Colonel was established for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han Ming: Yiquan land; Yihe Colonel for farming.

sentences.zh: 竇憲、班超大破西域，始於此築城。

translations.literal: Dou Xian and Ban Chao greatly defeated the Western Regions and first built a walled city here.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Xian and Ban Chao defeated Western Regions; first city here.

sentences.zh: 班勇為西域長史，居此地也。

translations.literal: Ban Yong was Chief Clerk of the Western Regions and dwelt in this place.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Yong Western Regions Chief Clerk; dwelt here.

translations.literal: Under Northern Wei and Northern Zhou the Shanshan Rong lived here.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Wei and Northern Zhou Shanshan Rong here.

sentences.zh: 隋始于漢伊吾屯城之東築城，為伊吾郡。

translations.literal: The Sui first built a city east of the old Han Yiwu garrison city and made it the Yiwu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sui built east of Han Yiwu garrison; Yiwu commandery.

translations.literal: At the end of the Sui it was held by the Rong.
In the fourth year of Wude they submitted and Western Yi Prefecture was first established here.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: submitted; Western Yi first here.

sentences.zh: 天山，在州北一百二十里，一名白山，胡人呼折羅漫山

translations.literal: Mount Tianshan lies one hundred twenty li north of the prefecture, also called Mount Bai; the Hu call it Mount Zheluoman.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tianshan 120 li north, also Bai; Hu Zheluoman.

sentences.zh: 置，取縣東柔遠故城為名

translations.literal: Established, taking the name from the old Rouyuan city east of the county.
translations.idiomatic: Established; from old Rouyuan east of county.

sentences.zh: ，于鄯善胡所築之城置納職縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude Nazhi County was established at the city built by Shanshan Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: Nazhi at Shanshan Hu city.

translations.literal: Sha Prefecture, lower grade, in Sui times the Dunhuang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Prefecture, lower grade: Sui Dunhuang commandery.

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude Gua Prefecture was established.
In the fifth year of Wude it was changed to Western Sha Prefecture.
In the eighth year of Zhenguan the character xi was dropped.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Dunhuang commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Sha Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣二，戶四千二百六十五，口一萬六千二百五十。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed two counties, with 4,265 households and 16,250 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北三千六百五十里，至東都四千三百九里。

translations.literal: It lay 3,650 li northwest of the capital and 4,309 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 3,650 li northwest of capital, 4,309 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Dunhuang, Han commandery and county names.
translations.idiomatic: Dunhuang: Han commandery and county names.

sentences.zh: 月氐戎之地，秦、漢之際來屬。

translations.literal: The land of the Yuezhi Rong; in Qin and Han times it came under submission.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhi Rong land; Qin and Han submission.

sentences.zh: 漢武開西域，分酒泉置燉煌郡及縣。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han opened the Western Regions and split Jiuquan to establish the Dunhuang commandery and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wu opened Western Regions; Dunhuang commandery from Jiuquan.

sentences.zh: 周改燉煌為鳴沙縣，取縣界山名。

translations.literal: Zhou changed Dunhuang to Mingsha County, taking the mountain name within the bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dunhuang to Mingsha; mountain name.

translations.literal: The Sui restored Dunhuang.

sentences.zh: ，置瓜州，取《春秋》「祖吾離於瓜州」之義。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude Gua Prefecture was established, taking the meaning from the Spring and Autumn passage about Zuwu departing at Gua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 5: Gua; from Spring and Autumn Gua passage.

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wude it was changed to Western Sha Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皆治于三危山，在縣東南二十里。

translations.literal: All were administered from Mount Sanwei, twenty li southeast of the county.
translations.idiomatic: All at Mount Sanwei 20 li southeast.

sentences.zh: 鳴沙山，一名沙角山，又名神沙山，取州名焉，在縣七里

translations.literal: Mount Mingsha, also Mount Shajiao and Mount Shensha, gives the prefecture its name; seven li from the county.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Mingsha, also Shajiao and Shensha; gives prefecture name; 7 li from county.

translations.literal: Shouchang, the territory of Han Longle County, subordinate to Dunhuang commandery.
South of the county is Mount Longle.
Northern Wei changed it to Shouchang County.
Yang Pass lies six li west of the county.

sentences.zh: 玉門關，在縣西北一百一十八里。

translations.literal: Yumen Pass lies one hundred eighteen li northwest of the county.

sentences.zh: 西州，中，都督府，本高昌國。

translations.literal: Xi Prefecture, middle grade, protectorate, originally the Gaochang kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Prefecture, middle protectorate: originally Gaochang kingdom.

sentences.zh: ，平高昌，置西州都督府，仍立五縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, when Gaochang was pacified, the Xi Prefecture protectorate was established and five counties were still set up.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan 9: Gaochang pacified; Xi protectorate; five counties.

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenguan it was changed to a protectorate.
In the first year of Tianbao it was changed to the Jiaohe commandery.
After the Zhide era it was again made Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舊領縣五，戶六千四百六十六。

translations.literal: Formerly it governed five counties, with 6,466 households.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣五，戶九千一十六，口四萬九千四百七十六。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed five counties, with 9,016 households and 49,476 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北五千五百一十六里，至東都六千二百一十五里。

translations.literal: It lay 5,516 li northwest of the capital and 6,215 li from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 5,516 li northwest of capital, 6,215 li to Luoyang.

translations.literal: Gaochang, the court of the Former Cheshi king.

sentences.zh: 漢元帝置戊己校尉于此。

translations.literal: Under Han Emperor Yuan the Wuji Colonel was established here.

sentences.zh: 以其地形高敞，故名高昌。

translations.literal: Because the terrain is high and open, it is called Gaochang.
Its old ramparts have eight cities.

sentences.zh: 張駿置高昌郡，後魏因之。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun established the Gaochang commandery; Northern Wei followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun Gaochang commandery; Northern Wei followed.

sentences.zh: 魏末為蠕蠕所據，後麹嘉稱高昌王於此數代。

translations.literal: At the end of Wei it was taken by the Ruru; later Qu Jia called himself king of Gaochang here for several generations.
translations.idiomatic: Wei end Ruru; Qu Jia Gaochang king for generations.

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan it was pacified and the land became Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其高昌國境，東西八百里，南北五百里。

translations.literal: The Gaochang kingdom bounds were eight hundred li east-west and five hundred li north-south.
translations.idiomatic: Gaochang bounds 800 li east-west, 500 li north-south.

sentences.zh: 尋置都督府，又改為金山都督府。

translations.literal: Soon a protectorate was established and again changed to the Jinshan protectorate.
Established.

sentences.zh: 縣界有交河，水源出縣北天山，一名祁連山，縣取水名。

translations.literal: Within the county bounds is the Jiao River; its source comes from Mount Tianshan north of the county, also called Mount Qilian; the county takes the river name.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao River in bounds; source Mount Tianshan north, also Qilian; county from river.

translations.literal: Jiaohe, originally the court of the Han Former Cheshi king.

sentences.zh: ，於始昌故城置，縣東南有蒲類海，胡人呼為婆悉海

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Wude it was established at the old Shichang city; southeast of the county is Lake Pulei, which the Hu call Lake Bosi.
translations.idiomatic: Wude 4: at old Shichang; Lake Pulei southeast, Hu Bosi.

translations.literal: Established, taking Mount Qilian as the name.
Xiong Prefecture, within Liang Prefecture bounds.
Wen Prefecture, within Liang Prefecture bounds.
Fang Prefecture, within Liang Prefecture bounds.

sentences.zh: 北庭都護府都護府，，侯君集討高昌，西突厥屯兵於浮圖城，與高昌相回應。

translations.literal: Beiting Protectorate-General: when Hou Junji attacked Gaochang, the Western Turks garrisoned at Fotu city in mutual support with Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: Beiting: Hou Junji against Gaochang; Western Turks at Fotu with Gaochang.

translations.literal: When Gaochang was pacified.

sentences.zh: 二十年四月，西突厥泥伏沙缽羅葉護阿史那賀魯率眾內附，乃置庭州，處葉護部落。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, fourth month, the Western Turk Nivasha Boluoyehu Ashina Helu led his people to submit; Ting Prefecture was established to settle the yabghu tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Year 20 month 4: Ashina Helu submitted; Ting for yabghu tribes.

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo it was changed to the Beiting Protectorate-General.

sentences.zh: 自永徽至天寶，北庭節度使管鎮兵二萬人，馬五千匹；

translations.literal: From Yonghui through Tianbao the Beiting military commissioner commanded twenty thousand garrison troops and five thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghui through Tianbao: Beiting 20,000 troops, 5,000 horses.

sentences.zh: 所統攝突騎施、堅昆、斬啜；

translations.literal: It also supervised the Turgesh, Jiankun, and Chuyue.

sentences.zh: 又管瀚海、天山、伊吾三軍鎮兵萬余人，馬五千匹。

translations.literal: It also commanded the Hanhai, Tianshan, and Yiwu three armies — over ten thousand garrison troops and five thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: Also Hanhai, Tianshan, Yiwu armies: 10,000+ troops, 5,000 horses.

translations.literal: By the Jianzhong era it fell to the Tibetans.
Formerly it governed one county, with 2,300 households.

sentences.zh: 天寶領縣三，戶二千二百二十六，口九千九百六十四。

translations.literal: Under Tianbao it governed three counties, with 2,226 households and 9,964 mouths.

sentences.zh: 在京師西北五千七百二十里，東至伊州界六百八十里，南至西州界四百五十里，西至突騎施庭一千六百里，北至堅昆七千里，東至回鶻界一千七百里。

translations.literal: It lay 5,720 li northwest of the capital; 680 li east to Yi Prefecture border; 450 li south to Xi Prefecture border; 1,600 li west to Turgesh Ting; 7,000 li north to Jiankun; 1,700 li east to Uyghur border.
translations.idiomatic: 5,720 li northwest of capital; borders as listed.

sentences.zh: 流沙州北，前漢烏孫部舊地，方五千里。

translations.literal: North of Liusha Prefecture; formerly the old land of the Former Han Wusun, five thousand li square.
translations.idiomatic: North of Liusha; Former Han Wusun land, 5000 li square.

translations.literal: Later Han court of the Later Cheshi king.

sentences.zh: 胡故庭有五城，俗號「五城之地」。

translations.literal: The old Hu Ting had five cities, popularly called the Land of Five Cities.
translations.idiomatic: Old Hu Ting five cities; Land of Five Cities.

sentences.zh: 平高昌後，置庭州以前，故及突厥常居之。

translations.literal: Before Ting Prefecture was established after pacifying Gaochang, the old city and Turks often dwelt here.
translations.idiomatic: Before Ting after Gaochang; old city and Turks dwelt here.

translations.literal: Named for Han Luntai.
Sea name.
The three counties above were established together with Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 軍開元中蓋嘉運置，在北庭都護府城內，管鎮兵萬二千人，馬四千二百匹。

translations.literal: Army: in the Kaiyuan era Gai Jiayun established it within the Beiting Protectorate city, commanding twelve thousand garrison troops and four thousand two hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan: Gai Jiayun army in Beiting city; 12,000 troops, 4,200 horses.

sentences.zh: 軍開元中，置西州城內，管鎮兵五千人，馬五百匹。

translations.literal: Army: in the Kaiyuan era established within the Xi Prefecture city, commanding five thousand garrison troops and five hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan: army in Xi city; 5,000 troops, 500 horses.

translations.literal: Five hundred li south of the protectorate.

sentences.zh: 軍開元中置，在伊州西北五百里甘露川，管鎮兵三千人，馬三百匹，在北庭府東南七百里。

translations.literal: Army: in the Kaiyuan era established at Ganlu Creek five hundred li northwest of Yi Prefecture, commanding three thousand garrison troops and three hundred horses, seven hundred li southeast of Beiting.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan: Ganlu Creek army; 3,000 troops, 300 horses; 700 li southeast of Beiting.

sentences.zh: :已上十六番州，雜戎胡部落，寄於北庭府界內，無州縣戶口，隨地治畜牧。

translations.literal: The sixteen fan prefectures above were mixed Rong and Hu tribes lodged within Beiting bounds without prefectural counties or household registers, herding by local pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen fan prefectures: mixed tribes in Beiting; no registers; herding.

sentences.zh: 安西大都護府，侯君集平高昌，置西州都護府，治在西州。

translations.literal: Anxi Superior Protectorate: when Hou Junji pacified Gaochang he established the Xi Prefecture Protectorate, administered from Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi: Hou Junji pacified Gaochang; Xi Protectorate at Xi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蘇定方平賀魯，分其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Su Dingfang pacified Helu and split the land to establish the Mengchi and Kunling two protectorate-generals.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Su Dingfang pacified Helu; Mengchi and Kunling protectorate-generals.

translations.literal: Their tribes were divided and states and counties were arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes divided; states and counties arrayed.

sentences.zh: 於是，西盡波斯國，皆隸安西都護府。

translations.literal: Thereupon west to the Persian state all were subordinate to the Anxi Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: West to Persia all under Anxi Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 仍移安西都護府理所于高昌故地。

translations.literal: The Anxi Protectorate seat was still moved to the old Gaochang land.
translations.idiomatic: Anxi seat moved to old Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，移安西府于龜茲國。

translations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, the Anxi office was moved to the Kucha state.
The old Anxi office again became Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Old Anxi office again Xi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: ，西域吐火羅款塞，乃于於闐以西、波斯以東十六國，皆置都督，督州八十，縣一百一十，軍府一百二十六，仍立碑于吐火羅以志之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianqing the Western Regions Tokhara submitted; then west of Khotan and east of Persia sixteen states all had protectors, supervising eighty prefectures, one hundred ten counties, and one hundred twenty-six army offices; a stele was still erected in Tokhara to record it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianqing 4: Tokhara submitted; sixteen states; eighty prefectures; stele in Tokhara.

sentences.zh: 四月，吐蕃陷安西都護府。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Tibetans captured the Anxi Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Tibetans captured Anxi Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 至，收復安西四鎮，依前于龜茲國置安西都護府。

translations.literal: By the Zhenyuan era the Anxi Four Garrisons were recovered and the Anxi Protectorate was again established at Kucha as before.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan: Four Garrisons recovered; Anxi at Kucha again.

sentences.zh: 至德後，河西、隴右戍兵皆徵集，收復兩京。

translations.literal: After the Zhide era Hexi and Longyou garrison troops were all mobilized to recover the two capitals.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhide: Hexi and Longyou troops mobilized for two capitals.

translations.literal: Hexi military garrisons mostly fell to the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 有舊將李元忠守北庭，郭昕守安西府，二鎮與沙陀、回鶻相依，吐蕃久攻之不下。

translations.literal: The old generals Li Yuanzhong held Beiting and Guo Xin held the Anxi office; the two garrisons relied on Shatuo and Uyghurs; the Tibetans attacked long without taking them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanzhong Beiting; Guo Xin Anxi; Shatuo and Uyghurs; Tibetans could not take.

sentences.zh: ，元忠、昕遣使間道奏事，德宗嘉之，以元忠為北庭都護，昕為安西都護。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianzhong Yuanzhong and Xin sent envoys by secret route to memorialize; Dezong praised them and made Yuanzhong Beiting Protector and Xin Anxi Protector.
translations.idiomatic: Jianzhong 3: secret memorial; Dezong made Yuanzhong Beiting Protector, Xin Anxi Protector.

sentences.zh: 其後，吐蕃急攻沙陀、回鶻部落，北庭、安西無援，，竟陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: Afterward the Tibetans urgently attacked Shatuo and Uyghur tribes; Beiting and Anxi had no aid and in the end fell to the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Tibetans attacked Shatuo and Uyghur; Beiting and Anxi without aid; fell to Tibetans.

translations.literal: Originally the Kucha state.

sentences.zh: 顯慶中，自西州移府治於此。

translations.literal: In the Xianqing era the office seat was moved here from Xi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xianqing: seat moved here from Xi.

sentences.zh: 東至焉耆鎮守八百里，西至疏勒鎮守二千里，南至於闐二千里，東北至北庭府二千里，南至吐蕃界八百里，北至突騎施界雁沙川一千里。

translations.literal: Eight hundred li east to the Yanqi garrison; two thousand li west to the Shule garrison; two thousand li south to Khotan; two thousand li northeast to Beiting; eight hundred li south to Tibetan border; one thousand li north to Turgesh border at Yansha River.
translations.idiomatic: Distances to garrisons and borders as listed.

sentences.zh: 安西都護府，鎮兵二萬四千人，馬二千七百匹。

translations.literal: Anxi Protectorate: twenty-four thousand garrison troops and two thousand seven hundred horses.
The protector also served as Zhenxi military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 安西都護所統四鎮本龜茲國。

translations.literal: The Four Garrisons under the Anxi Protector were originally the Kucha state.
translations.idiomatic: Four Garrisons under Anxi originally Kucha.

translations.literal: Its king's surname was Bai and he ruled south of Mount Bai.
translations.idiomatic: King surname Bai; ruled south of Mount Bai.

sentences.zh: 去瓜州三千里，勝兵數千。

translations.literal: Three thousand li from Gua Prefecture; several thousand able soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: 3,000 li from Gua; several thousand soldiers.

sentences.zh: ，阿史那社{人小}破之，虜龜茲王而還，乃於其地置都督府，領蕃州之九。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenguan Ashina She'er defeated them, captured the Kucha king and returned, and then established a protectorate office there, governing nine fan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan 4: Ashina She'er defeated; captured Kucha king; protectorate; nine fan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 至，破賀魯，仍自西州移安西府置於龜茲國城

translations.literal: By the Xianqing era Helu was defeated and the Anxi office was still moved from Xi Prefecture to the Kucha state city.
translations.idiomatic: Xianqing: Helu defeated; Anxi from Xi to Kucha city.

translations.literal: Originally the Khotan state.

sentences.zh: 在蔥嶺北二百里，勝兵數千。

translations.literal: Two hundred li north of the Cong Ridge; several thousand able soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: 200 li north of Cong Ridge; several thousand soldiers.

translations.literal: The people are very clever by custom.
Its king Fuxinxin came to court.

sentences.zh: 正月，置毗沙都督府，初管蕃州五。

translations.literal: In the first month the Pisha protectorate office was established, initially governing five fan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: First month: Pisha protectorate; five fan prefectures.

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianbao it was divided into ten.

sentences.zh: 在安西都護府西南二千里

translations.literal: Two thousand li southwest of the Anxi Protectorate.
Originally the Shule state.
South of Mount Bai; two thousand able soldiers.
Four thousand six hundred li from Gua Prefecture.
In the fourth year of Zhenguan they sent envoys with tribute and from then on it did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan 4: envoys with tribute; unceasing thereafter.

sentences.zh: 上元中，置疏勒都督府，在安西都護府西南二千里

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era the Shule protectorate office was established, two thousand li southwest of the Anxi Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyuan: Shule protectorate; 2,000 li southwest of Anxi.

translations.literal: Originally the Yanqi state.

sentences.zh: 其王姓龍，名突騎支，常役於西突厥。

translations.literal: Its king's surname was Long and his name was Tuqizhi; he was often subject to the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: King surname Long, name Tuqizhi; often subject to Western Turks.

translations.literal: By custom there is profit in fish and turtles.
translations.idiomatic: Custom: profit in fish and turtles.

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan Guo Xiaoke pacified them and thereafter they became subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenguan 9: Guo Xiaoke pacified; thereafter subjects.

sentences.zh: 上元中，置都督府處其部落，無蕃州。

translations.literal: In the Shangyuan era a protectorate office was established to settle their tribe; no fan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Shangyuan: protectorate for tribe; no fan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 在安西都護府東八百里。

translations.literal: Eight hundred li east of the Anxi Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 西域十六都督州府，西域諸國，遣使來內屬，乃分置十六都督府，州八十，縣一百一十，軍府一百二十六，皆隸安西都護府，仍于吐火羅國立碑以紀之。

translations.literal: The sixteen protectorate offices of the Western Regions: when the various states of the Western Regions sent envoys to submit internally, sixteen protectorate offices were divided and set up — eighty prefectures, one hundred ten counties, and one hundred twenty-six army offices — all subordinate to the Anxi Protectorate; a stele was still erected in the Tokhara state to record it.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Western Regions protectorate offices; eighty prefectures; all under Anxi; stele in Tokhara.

sentences.zh: 于吐火羅國所治遏換城置，以其王葉護領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Ehuang city administered by the Tokhara state, with its yabghu king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Tokhara Ehuang city; yabghu king leads.

sentences.zh: 於其部內分置二十四州，都督統之

translations.literal: Within its territory twenty-four prefectures were divided and a protector supervised them.

sentences.zh: 于嚈噠部落所治活路城置，以其王太汗領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Huolu city administered by the Yeda tribe, with its great khan leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Yeda Huolu city; great khan leads.

sentences.zh: 仍分其部置十五州，太汗領之

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish fifteen prefectures; the great khan led them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen prefectures split; great khan leads.

sentences.zh: 于訶達羅支國所治伏寶瑟顛城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Fubaosedian city administered by the Hedaluo branch state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Hedaluo Fubaosedian city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still within its parts established eight prefectures.

sentences.zh: 于解蘇國所治數瞞城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Shuman city administered by the Jiesu state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiesu Shuman city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 于骨咄施國所治妖沙城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Yaosha city administered by the Gutushi state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Gutushi Yaosha city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 于罽賓國所治遏紇城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Ehe city administered by the Jibin state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Jibin Ehe city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish eleven prefectures.

sentences.zh: 于失苑延國所治伏戾城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Fuli city administered by the Shiyuanyan state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Shiyuanyan Fuli city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 于石汗那國所治豔城置，以其王領之。

translations.literal: Established at the Yan city administered by the Shihanna state, with its king leading it.
translations.idiomatic: At Shihanna Yan city; king leads.

translations.literal: Still split its territory to establish the Shuangmi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 於護特健國所治遏密城置，仍分其部置沛薄、大秦二州

translations.literal: Established at the Emi city administered by the Huteguo state; still split its territory to establish Peibo and Daqin — two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At Huteguo Emi city; Peibo and Daqin split.

sentences.zh: 于怛沒國所治怛城置，仍分置栗弋州

translations.literal: Established at the Dan city administered by the Danmo state; still split to establish the Liyi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At Danmo Dan city; Liyi Prefecture split.

sentences.zh: 于烏拉喝國所治摩竭城置

translations.literal: Established at the Mojie city administered by the Wulaha state.

sentences.zh: 於護密多國所治抵寶那城置

translations.literal: Established at the Dibaona city administered by the Humiduo state.

sentences.zh: 于俱密國所治措瑟城置

translations.literal: Established at the Cuose city administered by the Jumi state.

sentences.zh: 於護密多國所治摸廷城置

translations.literal: Established at the Moting city administered by the Humiduo state.

sentences.zh: 於久越得犍國所治步師城置

translations.literal: Established at the Bushi city administered by the Jiuyuede state.
Established at the Ling city administered by the Persian state.

sentences.zh: :右西域諸國，分置羈縻州軍府，皆屬安西都護統攝。

translations.literal: The various states of the Western Regions above: jimi prefectures and army offices were divided and set up, all supervised by the Anxi Protector.
translations.idiomatic: Above Western Regions states: jimi prefectures and army offices under Anxi Protector.

translations.literal: From this time forward tribute missions did not cease.

sentences.zh: 今于安西府事末紀之，以表太平之盛業也。

translations.literal: Now at the end of the Anxi office account it is recorded to display the splendor of the age of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Now end of Anxi account recorded to display great peace splendor.
